summary: This is a Snowflake documentation page for the system function SYSTEM$GENERATE_SCIM_ACCESS_TOKEN. The function returns a new SCIM access token valid for six months, given the name of a security integration whose TYPE is SCIM. The page covers syntax, arguments, output, and a single example that retrieves a token for an integration named OKTA_PROVISIONING.
one_line: Documents the Snowflake system function that generates a six-month SCIM access token for a SCIM security integration.
key_facts: SYSTEM$GENERATE_SCIM_ACCESS_TOKEN returns a new SCIM access token that is valid for six months.
The integration_name argument must be the name of a security integration where TYPE = SCIM.
The integration name is case-sensitive, must be uppercase, and must be enclosed in single quotes.
The function returns the SCIM access token as a string.
The page's example retrieves the SCIM access token for an integration named OKTA_PROVISIONING.
The function belongs to the Snowflake documentation category Information, under Query Information.
The page's Usage notes section has no content in the clipped text.
